author: anon-df5e95db
content: Plan: Write differential proptests comparing C bcf_hdr_id2int against a Rust replacement for all 3 dictionary types (BCF_DT_ID, BCF_DT_CTG, BCF_DT_SAMPLE). Strategy: build headers with random contigs/filters/INFO/FORMAT/samples via proptest, then query every known name plus random absent names and assert C == Rust. Implementation will use a pre-built HashMap<Vec<u8>, i32> cache inside HeaderView for O(1) lookups, initialized from the hdr->id[] arrays at construction time.
